about: Hand-written expectations for #68 over the one-screen fixture (tests/test_issue68_similar_sequences.py and tools/qualify_similar_sequences.py). Letters stand for the activities of expected.json. The edit distance counts activities to insert, remove or replace; from A B D E: A B D, A D E, A B C D E and A C B D E are one edit away, A B C B D E and A D two. At equal distance the family with more incidents comes first, then the sequence in the order of its activity names. Never read by product code.
